questions.q: In “Please give a concise summary,” which word is closest to concise?
questions.e: Concise veut dire brief : bref et précis.

questions.q: In “The repair required a substantial amount of money,” which word is closest to substantial?
questions.e: Substantial veut dire considerable : important, considérable.

questions.q: In “She was reluctant to accept the offer,” which word is closest to reluctant?
questions.e: Reluctant veut dire unwilling : peu disposé.

questions.q: In “The report provides accurate figures,” which word is closest to accurate?
In “The new law will abolish the old rule,” which verb is closest to abolish?
questions.e: Abolish veut dire supprimer ou mettre fin à.

questions.q: In “Researchers assessed the impact of the programme,” which verb is closest to assessed?

questions.e: Ambiguous veut dire unclear : qui peut être compris de plusieurs façons.

questions.q: In “The community proved resilient after the flood,” which phrase is closest to resilient?
